name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2026-06-26, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
